dialogs.about: 아침 식탁에서 가족과 오늘 계획 나누기

lines.en: Breakfast is on the table. Come and eat.
lines.ko: 아침 식사가 식탁에 있어요. 와서 먹어요.

lines.en: This bread smells good. Did you make it this morning?
lines.ko: 이 빵 냄새 좋네요. 오늘 아침에 만들었어요?

lines.en: Yes, I made it early this morning.
What is our family doing today?
Our grandson will visit us after school.
lines.ko: 손자가 학교 끝나고 우리를 보러 올 거예요.

lines.en: Great. I will buy some fruit for him.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 내가 손자 줄 과일을 좀 살게요.

lines.en: My mother is coming, too.
Your mother? Is your father coming with her?
No, he is tired. He walked a lot yesterday.
I see. Let's eat. More bread, please.
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 먹어요. 빵 좀 더 주세요.

dialogs.about: 손자에게 빵과 우유 챙겨주며 학교 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. Here is your bread and milk.
Thank you, Grandma. I love this bread.
lines.ko: 고마워요, 할머니. 저 이 빵 정말 좋아해요.

lines.en: Eat your breakfast slowly. Is school fun?
Yes! Yesterday I made a new friend at school.
lines.ko: 네! 어제 학교에서 새 친구를 사귀었어요.

lines.en: That's nice. What is the child's name?
I don't know his name. He is very kind.
Ask his name today and play together.
I will ask him after lunch.
Good. Will your mother pick you up today?
No, my father will come. See you, Grandma!
lines.ko: 아니요, 아빠가 올 거예요. 할머니, 다녀올게요!
